No variant satisfies the 9-of-9 PASS gate (MDD reduction is the primary blocker — Plan §12 minimum -3pp vs M4 NOT achieved by any). CONDITIONAL_PASS not appropriate: Plan §12 CONDITIONAL_PASS requires '+1~3pp MDD improvement' from M4 — best variant M4+LRO_cash achieves only +0.42pp (below 1pp minimum).
